tools.name: get-current-view
tools.description: Read the current on-page context: active section, location filter, and date window.

tools.name: navigate-to
tools.description: Jump to a Radar section by its key (e.g. 'traffic', 'dns', 'routing') or an internal path, optionally with a widget anchor (e.g. '/traffic#http-version'). Use the search tool to find sections and their deep links.

section.description: A Radar section key or internal path (may include #anchor).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Radar for pages, sections, events, and entities (domains, TLDs, ASNs, IPs, IP prefixes, bots, certificate authorities/logs, cloud origins, URL scans). Mirrors the site search bar. Returns matching titles and their internal Radar paths; use 'navigate-to' to open one.

tools.name: set-date-range
tools.description: Change the date window. Provide a relative 'dateRange' (e.g. '7d', '28d', '12w', '52w') or an explicit 'dateStart' and 'dateEnd' (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: set-location
tools.description: Filter Radar to a country, region, continent, or ASN (e.g. 'US', 'europe', 'AS13335'). Pages that can't be filtered by that location redirect to one that can.

location.description: Country code, region/continent slug, or ASN.
